name: Navin Fluorine International Limited
summary: Navin Fluorine International Limited manufactures and sells specialty fluorochemicals in India and internationally. The company offers refrigerants for various applications, including room air conditioning, commercial refrigeration, industrial cooling, mobile air conditioning, cold chain, and heat pumps under the Mafron brand for original equipment manufacturers, service technicians, and equipment owners.
